_README: This file is the week's voice. Planning Center supplies the facts — order of service, songs, giving totals, sign-up links and dates, groups. Everything here is what a person writes. Edit it in the admin page at /sunday/admin/, or edit it here directly if you are comfortable with JSON. Links are written by NAME, not by ID: {"signup": "discover sojo"} is looked up against live Planning Center every build, so a sign-up that gets closed or deleted quietly drops off the page instead of 404ing a guest.
label: Community Sunday

hero.headline:
Not from a stage.
Around a table.
hero.lede: This is how “deeper together” actually happens — around a table with people who know your name. This morning we’re introducing our new small group leaders and praying over them as a church. Come stand with them.

welcome_note: Welcome. If you’re new here, we’re so glad you came. Fill out a Connect Card if you haven’t already — and consider giving us five Sundays. That’s about how long it takes to stop feeling like a visitor.

flow._README: Planning Center gives the order. These rename items and add the one line of detail a guest needs. Keys match the PCO item title, lowercased. 'hide' drops an item. 'insert' adds something PCO does not carry (Communion). '{{songs}}' expands to the worship set, '{{songs_after}}' to the response song.

baptism.title: Baptism
baptism.detail: Somebody is going public with their faith this morning.

closing announcements.title: Praying Over Our Leaders
closing announcements.detail: Introducing our new small group leaders and praying over them together.

insert.title: Communion
insert.detail: The table is open to anyone who follows Jesus. If that’s not you yet, no pressure — just let it pass.

note_prompts: What landed on you this morning?
Who already knows your name here — and who doesn’t yet?
One name you’re going to learn before you leave the room.
One person you’re going to bring to BABEL next Sunday.

ways.label: Check
ways.text: Made out to SOJO Church. Hand it to an usher when they come by.

ways.label: Cash
ways.text: Use an envelope and put your name on it — that’s the only way we can credit the gift to you at the end of the year.

ways.label: Online
ways.text: One time or recurring, from your phone. Takes about a minute.

fallback.asof: Giving figures are updated each week from Planning Center.

announcements.title: BABEL
announcements.body: We are still building towers. New series — every week stands on its own.

announcements.title: Genesis 1–11
announcements.body: The soil the whole story grows out of. Youth and adults meet separately.

announcements.title: Discover More
announcements.body: Three weeks on the essentials. Bring your questions.

announcements.title: Fields of Faith
announcements.body: Youth, at Atrium Health Ballpark in Kannapolis. We meet outside the gates.

swag.title: Every shirt is a Bible
swag.body: Printed on demand when you order it, so nothing sits in a box in a closet. And every piece that sells puts a Bible in the hands of somebody who just met Jesus.

pastor_notes.title: Twenty-five new faces
pastor_notes.body: Our first Discover SOJO in the new home was packed — about twenty-five people who said, “I want to know more about this place.” So here’s your job. If you see someone you don’t recognize this morning, don’t wait for a greeter. Say hi. Learn a name. Invite them to sit with you. That’s how a crowd becomes a family.

pastor_notes.title: Thank you, Jessica and Sarah
pastor_notes.body: Oktoberfest happened because two people said yes and then did the work. Jessica and Sarah — thank you for putting us on our own back doorstep with the love of Jesus. And to everyone who served: you were people of peace this weekend. Well done.

invite.art_alt: BABEL — a five-week series at SOJO Church. Old gods. New names. Genesis 11 to Acts 2.
invite.lede: A whole civilization decided it could build its way to God. We are still building towers — money, power, politics, technology. Same old gods, new names. Bring one person who’s asking why the world feels the way it does right now.
invite.text: Come with me to church next week — we’re talking about the craziness in the world and how God’s plan is better than we can ever imagine. 9:00 or 11:00 at Gibson Mill, 325 McGill Ave. About an hour and change. https://sojo.church

groups._README: Used only if the Planning Center Groups read comes back empty.

buttons._README: The two calls to action under the order of service and under the groups list. A button whose link will not resolve is dropped rather than shipped dead.
